latin.vocab.hypernym_substitution.description: Gave the general word where the specific one was asked for.
latin.vocab.hypernym_substitution.example: avis (bird) for anas (duck), both in the word bank
latin.vocab.hypernym_substitution.remediation_strategy: Picture-pair discrimination between the general and specific word, then the same pair in a full sentence.

latin.vocab.confusable_pair.description: Swapped two words of the same kind from the word bank.
latin.vocab.confusable_pair.remediation_strategy: Side-by-side discrimination of the two words with their meanings, then mixed recall.

latin.vocab.unknown_word.description: Wrote a word that is not in the word bank.
latin.vocab.unknown_word.remediation_strategy: Re-introduce the word bank meanings, then picture-to-word retrieval.

latin.macron_omission.description: Right word, missing a macron the teacher marked.
latin.macron_omission.remediation_strategy: Say the long vowel aloud while writing it, then copy-and-check practice.

latin.question.what_vs_doing.description: Answered what something is when asked what it is doing, or the reverse.
latin.question.what_vs_doing.remediation_strategy: Pair each question with its kind of answer: Quid est? names it, Quid agit? says the action.

latin.verb.person_number.description: Wrong verb ending for the subject.
latin.verb.person_number.remediation_strategy: Ending-substitution drill with one and many.

latin.noun.case_ending.description: Wrong noun ending for its job in the sentence.
latin.noun.case_ending.remediation_strategy: Chant the ending, then fill-ins that need it.

latin.word_order.description: Words in an order that changes or hides the meaning.
latin.word_order.remediation_strategy: Build sentences from word cards, reading each aloud.

latin.translation_direction.description: Translated the wrong way, Latin for English or English for Latin.
latin.translation_direction.remediation_strategy: Read the instruction aloud first, then a short translate-this-way set.

latin.unclassified.description: A miss this pack cannot explain; the parent is asked.
latin.unclassified.remediation_strategy: No practice is generated until the parent describes the miss.

strengths.latin.verbs.action_words: Named the action correctly when asked Quid agit?
strengths.latin.nouns.naming: Named the animal correctly when asked Quid est?
strengths.latin.macrons: Wrote macrons where the word needs them
strengths.latin.colors: Matched every colour word to its colour
strengths.latin.word_bank_fill: Chose the right word from the bank for every blank
